- Physical exam findings (e.g., presence/size of lymph nodes, spleen size) — needed to evaluate for lymphadenopathy or splenomegaly, which would support SLL or advanced CLL  
- Imaging results (CT neck/chest/abdomen/pelvis) — necessary to assess nodal/extranodal burden and distinguish CLL-predominant vs. SLL-predominant disease  
- Bone marrow biopsy report — not required for diagnosis, but would clarify etiology of borderline cytopenias if ALC is subthreshold  
- Serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), beta-2-microglobulin, or CRP — nonspecific but supportive markers of tumor burden/inflammation in context of unexplained weight loss

Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia / Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (CLL/SLL) — *pending confirmation of absolute lymphocyte count ≥5.0 ×10⁹/L*
